_comment: 2016APV counterpart of trijet_data_2018_minimal_rho_pairsplit.json. Systematics-grade minimal_rho trijet DATA production on the 2026-08-06 pair_split fiducial. The systematic profile is left at minimal_syst because it is a no-op on data: the jetsyst loop skips every non-nominal entry when do_gen is False, and the data weights object carries no variations, so data is nominal-only by construction whatever the profile says. Also carries the per-jet kinematic validation hists, which is the point of the run -- they are the data leg of the per-year pair_split kinematic data/MC ratios. JetHT Run2016B-ver1/ver2, C, D, E, F (HIPM_UL2016), 296 files. Era plumbing for 2016APV: JEC Summer19UL16APV_V7_MC / Summer19UL16APV_Run{BCD,EF}_V7_DATA, JER Summer20UL16APV_JRV3_MC, lumi 19.5 fb^-1, golden JSON Cert_271036-284044_13TeV_Legacy2016_Collisions16_JSON.txt, prescales/ps_weight_JSON_2016.json (2016APV shares the 2016 table); the Run2016B-ver2 dataset takes the PFJet path set instead of AK8PFJet (dijet_processor keys on 'ver2' in the dataset name -> ps_weight_JSON_PFJet2016.json). The fileset qualifier that selects this era's datasets is set by notebook_utils.HADRONIC_ERAS_DATA; the processor re-derives the same IOV from the DAS name, so nothing here needs an explicit IOV key.
